nodes.label: deterministic_fallback labelling
nodes.rationale: Any provider failure/timeout/invalid JSON falls back to deterministic guidance clearly labelled deterministic_fallback so fallback is never disguised as AI and the triage page can name which source produced the answer.

nodes.label: EmergencyRuleEngine — deterministic Stage-1 red-flag gate
nodes.rationale: A match immediately halts triage, logs emergency_triggered=true and safety.emergency_rule_matched, and opens an alertdialog with DB hotlines; no AI call is made, so red flags always win and emergency handling cannot degrade with model/provider outages.

nodes.label: Provider data minimization in symptom checks
nodes.norm_label: provider data minimization in symptom checks
nodes.rationale: Only symptom text/duration/severity/onset/body-region are sent to the provider; name, email, patient code and record history are withheld, and every check is owner-only and logged, limiting PHI exposure to a third-party AI.

nodes.label: Stage 2 AI strict-JSON contract (summary, urgency, questions, specialty_hint)
nodes.norm_label: stage 2 ai strict-json contract (summary, urgency, questions, specialty_hint)
nodes.rationale: The AI is explicitly told no diagnosis, no dosing, no certainty, and output is schema-validated; a specialty hint is cross-validated against the active specialty table before use, preventing hallucinated specialization.

nodes.label: symptom_check_logs audit table
nodes.rationale: Full source/urgency payloads are retained for clinical audit while the Recent checks UI shows only a compact summary, keeping the patient surface light without losing auditability.

nodes.label: Symptom checker routes (/patient/symptom-checker, POST /patient/symptom-check)
nodes.rationale: Endpoint is patient-only, CSRF-protected, throttled with the chatbot limiter and returns Cache-Control: no-store so symptom data is neither shared across users nor cached.

nodes.label: symptom_specialty_map scoring with General Medicine fallback
nodes.norm_label: symptom_specialty_map scoring with general medicine fallback
nodes.rationale: Symptom keywords are scored against the active map and the top active mapping wins, with General Medicine as the no-match default, so a specialty is always chosen from real DB data rather than invented.

nodes.label: Phase 5 patient AI: Stage-1 deterministic red-flag gate then Stage-2 specialist/guidance with AI cross-validation fallback
nodes.norm_label: phase 5 patient ai: stage-1 deterministic red-flag gate then stage-2 specialist/guidance with ai cross-validation fallback

nodes.label: Deviation: no production AI key committed
nodes.norm_label: deviation: no production ai key committed
nodes.rationale: Stage-2 OpenAI support is implemented with strict JSON, timeout and cross-validation, but the demo intentionally runs the deterministic fallback unless OPENAI_API_KEY plus ai_enabled/ai_model are configured; red flags never wait for AI.

nodes.norm_label: admin\settingscontroller (clinic, locale, booking, ai and revenue settings)

nodes.norm_label: reasoned cancel-on-behalf with slot release and notifications

nodes.label: Password + Typed-Phrase Danger Actions (PURGE, DELETE, RESET)
nodes.norm_label: password + typed-phrase danger actions (purge, delete, reset)

nodes.label: Two-Step CSV Medicine Import (dry-run token then transactional apply)
nodes.norm_label: two-step csv medicine import (dry-run token then transactional apply)
nodes.rationale: Import writes only after an explicit dry-run token and the apply step is transactional, so a bad import cannot half-write pharmacy stock.

nodes.label: Leave-Aware Date Strip and Slot Picker with Server-Authoritative Validation
nodes.norm_label: leave-aware date strip and slot picker with server-authoritative validation
nodes.rationale: Availability is re-checked server-side and no client-provided availability is trusted; the DB unique violation is surfaced as a user-facing 'slot just taken' error rather than pre-filtering with fabricated rows.

nodes.label: Phase 5 Two-Stage AI Symptom Checker Pipeline
nodes.norm_label: phase 5 two-stage ai symptom checker pipeline

nodes.label: CSV Formula-Injection Escaping (= + - @, tab, CR)
nodes.rationale: Exported spreadsheets are opened in Excel/Sheets, so leading = + - @ plus tab and CR are neutralised to prevent imported data from executing as formulas.

nodes.label: Effective-Dated Revenue Percentage with Impact Preview and History
nodes.norm_label: effective-dated revenue percentage with impact preview and history
nodes.rationale: Future revenue rows never re-price history: commission changes must not retroactively alter already-issued invoices, so revenue configs are effective-dated and history is preserved.

nodes.label: Deferral of AI Stage-2 Symptom-to-Specialty Pipeline to Phase 5
nodes.norm_label: deferral of ai stage-2 symptom-to-specialty pipeline to phase 5
nodes.rationale: Safety first: Part 4 ships the authenticated FAQ/rule-first assistant, and red flags still escalate deterministically through the pinned disclaimer, so the emergency path never depends on AI.

nodes.label: Stored-but-Untransported Email/SMS Notification Preferences
nodes.rationale: The in-app feed is authoritative; preference toggles are persisted now so transport providers can be wired later without a schema change.

nodes.label: Owner-Only Patient Scoping (patient_id check, 403 for other accounts)
nodes.norm_label: owner-only patient scoping (patient_id check, 403 for other accounts)
nodes.rationale: Controllers resolve the patient from auth()->user()->patient and PDF endpoints additionally compare patient_id, so URL guessing cannot expose another patient's clinical or billing records.

nodes.label: EndToEndJourneyTest
nodes.rationale: One no-shortcuts journey across all four portals is the only check that proves the portals compose: registration through discharge plus the audit trail, asserted in a single run.

nodes.label: Labelled Deterministic Fallback
nodes.rationale: Timeouts, HTTP failures and malformed JSON must surface a labelled deterministic answer rather than a silent failure or an unlabelled AI claim, so provenance is never ambiguous.

nodes.label: Prescription History (read-only)
nodes.rationale: Read-only because corrections are modelled as a new prescription plus pharmacy cancellation workflow, preserving the append-only clinical trail and preventing retroactive edits.

nodes.label: AI Safety Text Re-displayed with Provenance
nodes.norm_label: ai safety text re-displayed with provenance
nodes.rationale: The gate re-displays AI text with its stored status but deterministic checks decide every blocker, so pharmacy staff can never mistake advisory text for the blocking rule.

nodes.label: Atomic Dispense Transaction
nodes.rationale: Stock deduction, ledger rows, invoice issuance, prescription closure, audit logging and notifications must all succeed or roll back together; any partial commit would desynchronise clinical and inventory records.

nodes.label: Derived Workflow Status
nodes.rationale: A single mutable patients.workflow_status column cannot represent per-visit progress, so status is derived from the latest prescription/invoice and current stock and therefore cannot drift from the underlying records.

nodes.label: Dispense & Bill
nodes.rationale: Money is computed server-side via a no-store quote endpoint so the client only renders pre-formatted strings and cannot influence totals.

nodes.label: Append-only Inventory Ledger
nodes.rationale: Every stock change must produce a ledger row and existing rows are immutable, so refunds and corrections cannot silently move stock.

nodes.label: Partial Dispense Rejection
nodes.rationale: The schema has no partial-dispense state, and closing a prescription while only part of the course was supplied would misrepresent treatment; the pharmacist must dispense the full quantity or refuse.

nodes.label: Invoice Price Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Invoice lines use the prescription price snapshot rather than current catalogue price so later price changes cannot rewrite historical bills.

nodes.label: Pharmacy Safety Gate
nodes.rationale: Safety is re-evaluated at the counter inside the transaction rather than trusting the doctor-time snapshot, and dispense stays locked until identity, dose, quantity and counselling (plus any sealed override) are acknowledged.

nodes.label: Append-only Audit Trail (activity_log)
nodes.rationale: activity_log and inventory_ledger are immutable at the model layer with no update/delete routes, so clinical and stock history can be trusted as evidence.

nodes.label: Prescription Details Accordion (item table + doctor note)
nodes.norm_label: prescription details accordion (item table + doctor note)

nodes.label: Pharmacy KPI Row (pending Rx / low stock / billed today)
nodes.norm_label: pharmacy kpi row (pending rx / low stock / billed today)

nodes.label: Add Medicine Modal (generic, ingredient, class, aliases)
nodes.norm_label: add medicine modal (generic, ingredient, class, aliases)

nodes.label: Inventory Table (stock vs threshold, batch expiry, badges)
nodes.norm_label: inventory table (stock vs threshold, batch expiry, badges)

nodes.label: ConfirmModal Component (Click / Typed / Reason variants)
nodes.rationale: Friction scales with blast radius — click for routine confirmations, typed or reason-required for destructive ones — and submit errors keep the modal open with context intact.

nodes.label: DesignContractTest (token/scope/4-state enforcement)
nodes.rationale: Design rules are executable checks rather than documentation: token values, per-file SPEC citations, no currency glyphs, emergency-class scope and the 4-state contract all fail CI when violated.

nodes.label: RoleSidebar Component (one DOM instance)
nodes.rationale: Sticky column ≥992 and focus-trapped slide-over below 992 use a single DOM instance so navigation state and focus order never diverge between breakpoints.

nodes.label: Contextual Appointment Action Matrix
nodes.rationale: Actions shown are exactly the contextual set allowed per appointment status, so the UI never offers an action the state machine would reject.

nodes.label: Safety Check History Line (allergy + interaction passed)
nodes.norm_label: safety check history line (allergy + interaction passed)
nodes.rationale: Showing patients that allergy and interaction checks already passed at dispensing builds trust without exposing pharmacy-facing notes, and notes that pharmacy may not alter dosage.

nodes.label: Expired Batch Quarantine (+ ledger adjustment)
nodes.rationale: Quarantine writes an explicit negative adjustment with a reason rather than deleting rows, so expired stock disappears from search without erasing the audit trail.

nodes.label: UNIQUE(doctor_id, date, active_slot_key) booking constraint
nodes.rationale: One active booking per slot enforced in the database with terminal rows releasing the key, so concurrent double-booking loses at the constraint rather than by application check.

nodes.label: Unique Active-Slot Booking Key
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE(doctor_id, date, active_slot_key) lets the database arbitrate one active booking per slot while terminal rows release it, closing the double-booking race without application-level locking.

nodes.label: POST /api/chatbot Deterministic Red-Flag Intercept
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 chatbot is FAQ plus deterministic rules only (20/min/IP); AI retrieval/analysis arrives behind the same service contract in Phases 5 and 7 so the emergency path never depends on the model.

nodes.label: DataView Four States (success/skeleton/empty/error)
nodes.rationale: Uniform state contract with a shared ui.initialState and ?state= overrides makes every data-bound view testable for loading/empty/error without per-page bespoke code.

nodes.label: design-out Design System
nodes.rationale: tokens.json/scss, COMPONENT-SPEC.md and prototypes are the single source of truth: tokens port to Sass, each React component header cites its COMPONENT-SPEC section and prototype reference, and prototypes act as the visual acceptance target for Dusk screenshots and the exact-width frame harness.

nodes.label: Inertia 2 React Bridge
nodes.rationale: Inertia supplies server-driven props, pagination and validation without a second API surface while keeping React 18 and the no-client-trust posture.

nodes.label: Laravel 12 Monolith
nodes.rationale: PLAN specified Laravel 11, but the whole 11.x line is blocked by Composer security advisories; Laravel 12 is API-compatible with the planned schema, services, middleware, Blade/Inertia and Vite.

nodes.label: MediPath Platform
nodes.rationale: AI-powered doctor appointment and medicine safety system built as a CSE-479 lab project; scoped so that emergency/safety paths never depend on AI services.

nodes.label: MediPath Platform
nodes.rationale: AI-Powered Doctor Appointment and Medicine Safety System for CSE-479: four hardened role shells over one append-only clinical record graph, with AI strictly advisory behind deterministic safety gates.

nodes.label: Walk-in claim (WI-9001 demo / WI-4821 seeded record)
nodes.norm_label: walk-in claim (wi-9001 demo / wi-4821 seeded record)

nodes.label: Emergency Red Scope (#B91C1C)
nodes.rationale: Emergency red is confined to emergency surfaces only (emergency page kit, chatbot in-stream alert, escalation dialog, red-flag badges, hotline CTAs, navbar emergency link) while routine destructive actions use danger #DC2626, so red keeps its urgency signal; enforced by DesignContractTest.

nodes.label: Add Allergy Form (server duplicate rejection)
nodes.rationale: Duplicate active substances are rejected server-side by uniq(patient_id, substance) so safety lists cannot diverge in the client's favour.

nodes.label: Current Medications Table (prescribed + OTC self-reported)
nodes.rationale: Names feed the pairwise drug_interactions matrix; unmapped names still show to the doctor verbatim rather than being dropped.

nodes.label: Remove Allergy Confirm Modal (routine danger tone)
nodes.norm_label: remove allergy confirm modal (routine danger tone)
nodes.rationale: Uses routine danger red, not emergency red, because removing an allergy is a destructive-but-routine act; dependent prescription counts are shown before confirming.

nodes.label: Queue Filter Bar (stock status, waiting age, sort)
nodes.norm_label: queue filter bar (stock status, waiting age, sort)

nodes.label: Override Justification Review Modal (sealed record)
nodes.rationale: Overrides are immutable, co-signed records; pharmacy refusal is logged equally and returns the Rx to the doctor with a reason, keeping both directions auditable.

nodes.label: Restock Modal (stock in / adjustment with reason)
nodes.norm_label: restock modal (stock in / adjustment with reason)

nodes.label: Payment Status Modal (paid / refund with required reason)
nodes.norm_label: payment status modal (paid / refund with required reason)
nodes.rationale: Refunds require a reason visible to Admin oversight, and stock reversal stays a separate explicit ledger action so money and stock never move implicitly together.

nodes.label: Ingredient / Drug-Class / Alias Allergy Matching
nodes.rationale: Matching on ingredient, class and brand aliases (e.g. Penicillin catching Amoxicillin) keeps prescribing and dispensing safe even when names differ; lists are read live by doctors and the pharmacy gate.

nodes.label: Advisory Stock Check (pre-gate, double-check pattern)
nodes.rationale: Queue stock flags are advisory only; the authoritative gates re-run at dispensing so a stale queue row can never authorize an unsafe dispense.

nodes.label: Four Deterministic Gate Checks (allergy, interaction, batch expiry, stock)
nodes.norm_label: four deterministic gate checks (allergy, interaction, batch expiry, stock)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic rules are the gate and an AI summary is optional, so an AI outage cannot weaken safety; a failed engine is a hard stop that offers supervisor approval instead of silently passing.

nodes.label: 7-Step Atomic Dispense Transaction
nodes.rationale: Lock rows, validate stock, deduct, write ledger, bill, update Rx status and notify in one transaction; any failure rolls back all, so stock, ledger and invoice can never diverge.

nodes.label: stock_movements Immutable Ledger
nodes.rationale: Every stock change is a prev → change → new ledger row with actor and reference, never a direct edit, so inventory history is reconstructable and tamper-evident.

nodes.label: Six-Stage Clinical Journey Stepper
nodes.rationale: Registration → Prescription → Stock Check → Dispense → Billing → Discharged mirrors the physical counter, and a stock failure renders a blocked stage with reason instead of advancing.

nodes.label: RegistrationService (atomic multi-role registration)
nodes.rationale: User, profile, credential path, approval item and activity log commit in one transaction, so a partial registration can never leave an orphaned credential or account.

nodes.label: Walk-in Claim (placeholder @walkin records only)
nodes.rationale: Only placeholder records with no active account can be claimed, which prevents a code leak from hijacking a real patient's history.

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit (activity_log, inventory_ledger)
nodes.rationale: Audit and inventory ledgers are append-only at the model layer with no update or delete routes, so clinical history cannot be rewritten.

nodes.label: Append-only Activity Log & Inventory Ledger
nodes.rationale: Audit and inventory ledgers are append-only at the model layer with no update or delete routes, so clinical history cannot be rewritten.

nodes.label: AdminIdleTimeout Middleware
nodes.rationale: Tracks admin.last_activity server-side against config('medipath.security.admin_idle_minutes') (15); timeouts invalidate the session and redirect to /login, while JSON clients get 401 with code=admin_idle_timeout so API callers can distinguish expiry from ordinary unauthenticated errors.

nodes.label: Private Credential Preview Route
nodes.rationale: The credentials disk is private and never web-served; the preview route is admin-only, emits Cache-Control: no-store, private, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN, and writes credential.previewed on every open so viewing a licence is itself auditable.

nodes.label: Admin Governance Guards
nodes.rationale: Admins cannot change their own role, suspend or archive themselves, and the final active admin cannot be suspended/demoted/archived; typed archive validates the exact account name server-side so an accidental destructive action requires deliberate intent.

nodes.label: users.session_version Monotonic Auth Generation
nodes.rationale: Login/registration stamp the generation into the session; suspend, archive, role change, password reset and doctor resubmission/revocation increment it and delete the user's sessions rows, making revocation deterministic without enumerating Redis sessions.

nodes.label: Dependency-Counted Soft Delete Archive
nodes.rationale: Doctors and patients use archived_at rather than destructive deletes because appointments, prescriptions, reviews, schedules and invoices depend on them; dependency counts surface in the typed-confirm dialog and are recorded in the audit detail so archiving is an informed decision.

nodes.label: Part 2 Route to Prototype to Controller Map
nodes.norm_label: part 2 route to prototype to controller map

nodes.label: Atomic Role Change Transaction
nodes.rationale: Old role profile archived, new doctor/pharmacist profile and specialty/fee/licence created or revived, user role flipped, sessions cleared, and notification plus immutable activity entry all commit in one transaction so a partial role change can never leave mismatched profile and role state; a new doctor stays verification_status=pending until licence verification.

nodes.label: DataView Four-State Contract (Part 2)
nodes.rationale: Every Part 2 data view exposes Success/Skeleton/Empty/Error+Retry and honours ?state=, so the same screen can be demoed and tested in all four states without fixtures.

nodes.label: Read-Only Audited Portal Preview
nodes.rationale: Every as-patient open writes patient.portal_viewed, keeping staff access to patient history read-only yet attributable.

nodes.label: tbl-cards-md Dense Table Card Mode
nodes.rationale: Five-plus-column admin tables convert to cards between 640 and 1199px so the intermediate breakpoints stay readable, while the global COMPONENT-SPEC section 4 conversion below 640 and the desktop table at 1200px and above still apply.

nodes.norm_label: part 6 deviations: leave auto-cancels, blocks add/toggle only, stock not deducted at save, ai safety text deterministic fallback, claim code not self-claimable
nodes.rationale: Auto-cancel keeps audit and notification explicit instead of a silent state change; add/toggle-only blocks preserve simple overlap validation; stock deduction belongs to the Part 7 pharmacy dispense transaction; deterministic safety text never depends on an AI provider.

nodes.norm_label: doctor appointment requests: tabbed queue with accept, reasoned reject, complete, cancel-with-notice, audit entry and patient notification

nodes.norm_label: doctor reviews: read-only view of approved/pending/rejected reviews with rating distribution

nodes.norm_label: walk-in registration: patient, placeholder account, accepted appointment and wi-#### claim code created in one transaction with receipt

nodes.norm_label: authentication and role gates: session login, throttling, admin/verified-doctor/approved-pharmacist gates, self-action guard

nodes.norm_label: database schema with check constraints, unique active-slot key, append-only ledgers and fulltext indexes

nodes.norm_label: medipath — ai-powered doctor appointment and medicine safety system (cse-479)

nodes.norm_label: services layer: settingsservice, currencyformatter, activitylogservice, notificationservice, themeprovider

nodes.label: Part 6 doctor route map: controller-per-screen table gated by auth + role:doctor + verified.doctor
nodes.norm_label: part 6 doctor route map: controller-per-screen table gated by auth + role:doctor + verified.doctor

nodes.label: Deviation: Inertia 2 as the React bridge
nodes.norm_label: deviation: inertia 2 as the react bridge
nodes.rationale: PLAN allows a standalone React frontend; Inertia provides server-driven props/pagination/validation without a second API surface while keeping React 18 and no client-trust.

nodes.label: Deviation: Laravel 12 instead of Laravel 11
nodes.rationale: Laravel 11 releases are blocked by Composer's security advisory policy (unpatched advisories across the whole 11.x line); Laravel 12 is API-compatible with the PLAN architecture (same schema, services, middleware, Blade/Inertia, Vite).

nodes.label: Deviation: PHP 8.4 runtime
nodes.rationale: PHP 8.6 (machine default at scaffold time) emitted framework deprecations; PHP 8.4 is the supported Laravel 12 runtime.

nodes.label: Cancel-leave conflict modal with patient disposition choice
nodes.norm_label: cancel-leave conflict modal with patient disposition choice
nodes.rationale: Shows affected counts (accepted / pending / within 48h) and forces an explicit choice between notify-and-reschedule vs auto-cancel, because cancelling leave silently would orphan booked patients.

nodes.label: doctor_schedules weekday blocks
nodes.rationale: No overlapping blocks per weekday (validated inline); an empty schedule means patients cannot see or book the doctor, which is surfaced in the empty state.

nodes.label: Requests queue (Pending/Today/Upcoming/Completed/Cancelled)
nodes.rationale: The DB queue is the source of truth; an error banner states no decisions were lost, and upcoming rows are server-paginated so the doctor never works from a stale local list.

nodes.label: Reject with patient-visible reason
nodes.rationale: Rejection requires a mandatory reason shown to the patient, then notifies, logs activity, and releases the slot — a bare 'Reject' button would strand the slot without explanation.

nodes.label: Safety flags column (allergy severity)
nodes.rationale: Severe allergies are surfaced in the list itself (Penicillin, Peanuts) so risk is visible before a chart is opened or a prescription started.

nodes.label: Owner-scoped clinical access
nodes.rationale: Doctors never see patients they have not treated — access is scoped by appointments/prescriptions, and patient IDs are immutable keys so scoping cannot drift.

nodes.label: High-visibility allergy alert strip
nodes.rationale: Uses the clinical danger tone (not emergency UI), loads independently of the history tabs, and names the cross-reactive class (β-lactams → Amoxicillin/Ampicillin) so the alert stays actionable when other panels fail.

nodes.label: 3-tab clinical history (Rx / appointments / billing)
nodes.rationale: Billing is read-only for doctors — financial edits belong to pharmacy/admin — so clinical and financial authority stay separated inside one chart.

nodes.label: Permanently visible allergy-override justification
nodes.rationale: An overridden class-matched allergy keeps its justification text on the chart and inside PDFs forever, so an override can never become invisible history.

nodes.label: Optional AI safety summary (decision support only)
nodes.norm_label: optional ai safety summary (decision support only)
nodes.rationale: Off-by-default checkbox; deterministic checks remain the source of truth and the AI panel falls back with Retry if unavailable — AI adds prose, never authority.

nodes.label: Allergy class-match hard block on save
nodes.norm_label: allergy class-match hard block on save
nodes.rationale: A β-lactam match against a recorded penicillin allergy disables Save outright; the drug is also marked ALLERGY MATCH in search results so the block is visible before it is hit.

nodes.label: Pairwise drug-interaction matrix (minor→contraindicated)
nodes.rationale: Severity tiers come from the drug_interactions table; moderate pairs are advisory ('not blocking') while major pairs surface rhabdo-style risk, so alert fatigue does not flatten real contraindications.

nodes.label: Live pharmacy stock search with debounce
nodes.norm_label: live pharmacy stock search with debounce
nodes.rationale: Search returns stock, batch, expiry and double-dose warnings; if lookup fails the doctor may still type the medicine name because pharmacy verifies at dispensing.

nodes.label: Sealed override path (≥20-char justification + attestation)
nodes.rationale: Overriding a blocked allergy requires typed clinical justification and an explicit responsibility checkbox, logged with user and timestamp — the block is escapable but never silently.

nodes.label: Emergency red (#B91C1C) as a scoped palette
nodes.norm_label: emergency red (#b91c1c) as a scoped palette
nodes.rationale: Emergency red is reserved for life-threatening content only; routine errors elsewhere use the separate danger palette so red keeps its meaning.

nodes.label: Five-Role RBAC Model (Guest, Patient, Doctor, Pharmacist, Admin)
nodes.norm_label: five-role rbac model (guest, patient, doctor, pharmacist, admin)

nodes.label: Immediate Session Revocation and HTTP-only Cookies
nodes.norm_label: immediate session revocation and http-only cookies

nodes.label: Doctor KPI strip (server aggregation)
nodes.rationale: Four KPIs are date-scoped server aggregations; on failure the requests and timeline panels still load independently so one broken aggregate does not blank the day.

nodes.label: EnsureDoctorVerified middleware gate
nodes.rationale: The verified badge gates the whole workspace; unverified doctors are redirected to a read-only onboarding page, so clinical routes are never reachable pre-verification.

nodes.label: Today's timeline (slots, leave, walk-ins)
nodes.rationale: Timeline mixes confirmed visits, pending walk-in claims and schedule-derived lunch breaks, so the doctor sees one authoritative day view rather than separate lists.

nodes.label: Walk-in claim code (WI-4821-KD)
nodes.rationale: A printed/texted code lets a later self-registering patient merge the walk-in chart via patient.user_id, avoiding duplicate charts for the same human.

nodes.label: Same-phone duplicate chart detection
nodes.rationale: Matches on phone and offers 'Use PT-0377' vs 'Definitely a different person', so front-desk speed does not create duplicate clinical records.

nodes.label: Pending-account intercept to approval screen
nodes.rationale: Pending accounts are routed to the approval screen automatically, and suspended/archived accounts get support contact instead of a generic failure.

nodes.label: Post-login destination from DB role
nodes.rationale: Landing page is derived from the role stored in the database, never a guessed route — the same rule the pending screen uses for its activation button.

nodes.label: Patient walk-in claim code merge field
nodes.norm_label: patient walk-in claim code merge field
nodes.rationale: Optional claim code (WI-4821-KD) merges prior walk-in history at registration — the receiving half of the doctor-side walk-in flow.

nodes.label: License upload to admin approval queue
nodes.norm_label: license upload to admin approval queue
nodes.rationale: Doctor/pharmacist accounts stay pending until admin verifies the license; documents go to private disk visible only in the approval queue, not to other roles.

nodes.label: Role-conditional registration (patient / doctor / pharmacist)
nodes.rationale: One page reveals role-specific fields via CSS :has on the role radios; role labels are DB-driven and admin accounts are explicitly not self-registrable.

nodes.label: 3-stage approval stepper + queue position
nodes.rationale: Submitted → admin review → activation with a queue position and typical 2-business-day expectation, so waiting has a visible shape instead of an indefinite spinner.

nodes.label: Rejection reason + re-submit path
nodes.rationale: Reviewer's reason is quoted verbatim with a re-submit action, turning a dead-end rejection into a recoverable one.

nodes.label: Pending-token session (stays on screen until decision)
nodes.norm_label: pending-token session (stays on screen until decision)
nodes.rationale: A limited token keeps the applicant signed into only this status screen; polling GET /pending/status every 60s avoids email round-trips without granting workspace access.

nodes.label: Backup snapshots with restore drill
nodes.rationale: Failed backups stay visible with a Retry action and one snapshot is marked verified — a restore drill is surfaced, not just a green status list.

nodes.label: CSV export with formula-injection neutralisation
nodes.rationale: Leading =, +, −, @ are escaped and a timestamped manifest is included, so an exported spreadsheet cannot execute injected formulas.

nodes.label: Danger zone: password re-entry + typed DELETE
nodes.norm_label: danger zone: password re-entry + typed delete
nodes.rationale: Irreversible operations require password re-entry, dependency counts, and typed confirmation; nothing here touches clinical records (soft-archive only elsewhere).

nodes.label: Two-step CSV import (dry-run → apply)
nodes.rationale: Dry-run reports valid/invalid/update counts before anything is written; apply runs in one transaction with an audit entry and rollback restores the pre-import state.

nodes.label: Admin idle timeout (server middleware)
nodes.rationale: Logout-after-inactivity is enforced by server middleware (5–120 min window) rather than client JS, and danger-zone password re-entry is a separate toggle.

nodes.label: Active sessions with instant revocation
nodes.rationale: Revocation deletes DB session rows so cookies die on next request; the action is logged with actor + target ids — no client-side token blacklist delay.

nodes.label: 2FA/TOTP (planned)
nodes.rationale: Rendered as an unchecked 'planned' switch so the design documents intent without implying the control already ships.

nodes.label: Atomic patient + appointment + code transaction
nodes.rationale: Patient, slot and claim code commit as one unit; on slot collision the transaction rolls back completely rather than leaving a chart without an appointment.

nodes.label: Session auth with HTTP-only cookies + rate limiting
nodes.norm_label: session auth with http-only cookies + rate limiting
nodes.rationale: Server sessions rather than client tokens, with lockout after repeated failures; the error copy separates 'auth service unreachable' from 'wrong password' so users don't reset a valid credential.

nodes.label: Atomic registration (user + profile + credential doc)
nodes.rationale: User row, role profile and credential document commit in one transaction plus an approval-queue item and activity log, so a half-created account is impossible.

nodes.label: Email-enumeration-safe reset response
nodes.rationale: Responds identically whether or not an account exists, and resends idempotently, so the reset form cannot be used to discover registered emails.

nodes.label: Hashed one-time reset token (30-minute expiry)
nodes.rationale: Tokens are hashed with a 30-minute expiry and marked consumed on use; an expired token state explains that sessions cannot be revoked without a valid token rather than silently failing.

nodes.label: Reset revokes all other sessions
nodes.rationale: Password change kills other DB-backed sessions and signs in this device only, so a stolen session cannot survive a reset.

nodes.label: Append-only approval activity log
nodes.rationale: Every queue movement writes an append-only entry, so an approval decision is reconstructable after the fact.

nodes.label: Landing Page (Guest)
nodes.rationale: Public entry point that frames the product promise (verified doctors, safety-checked prescriptions, rule-first AI) while routing urgency to the offline emergency page rather than the chatbot.

nodes.label: {{CURRENCY}} clinic currency token
nodes.rationale: Currency code (BDT) drives a {{CURRENCY}} token rendered at runtime; the design never stores a literal dollar sign so every role renders the same configured symbol.

nodes.label: Leave manager (hides future slots only)
nodes.rationale: Leave hides future slots only; past bookings stay intact for records, and each leave row shows its blast radius ('6 slots hidden') before action.

nodes.label: Review moderation (one per completed appointment)
nodes.rationale: Unique constraint on appointment, admin approval before public display, and rejected reviews invisible to the doctor's public reply — prevents review stuffing and public replies to unpublished content.

nodes.label: Emergency strip that works offline
nodes.rationale: Small persistent CTA to Emergency Info, noted as working offline once loaded, so the emergency route is reachable from every guest surface.

nodes.label: Featured verified doctors grid
nodes.rationale: Server-paginated (doctors?featured=1&page=1) with an 'Under review' card whose Book button is disabled — unverified supply is shown transparently but never bookable.

nodes.label: Server-side URL-synced search filters
nodes.rationale: Filters are deep-linkable (GET /doctors?spec=cardio&min=4&today=1&page=1) and applied server-side, so a shared URL reproduces the same verified-only result set.

nodes.label: Availability by weekday filter
nodes.rationale: Computed from doctor_leaves + doctor_schedules so a weekday shown as available is genuinely bookable, not a stored flag.

nodes.label: Guest booking gate (sign in to book)
nodes.norm_label: guest booking gate (sign in to book)
nodes.rationale: Guests can view profile, availability and approved reviews but booking needs a patient account — the gate is stated up front rather than failing at submit.

nodes.label: Seven-day availability (SlotService: schedules − leaves − bookings)
nodes.rationale: Slots are derived per day (available / on leave / fully booked / clinic closed); on load failure it says records are intact rather than showing a guessing fallback.

nodes.label: Atomic Database Transaction with Full Rollback
nodes.norm_label: atomic database transaction with full rollback

nodes.label: Walk-In Claim Code for Patient Record Linking
nodes.norm_label: walk-in claim code for patient record linking

nodes.label: Invoice ID Search (server-scoped to patient ID)
nodes.norm_label: invoice id search (server-scoped to patient id)
nodes.rationale: Search results are scoped server-side to the caller's patient ID so no cross-account record can leak through a guessed invoice number.

nodes.label: Change Password Card (session revocation)
nodes.rationale: On success every other session is revoked instantly via DB-backed sessions, so a leaked session cannot survive a password change.

nodes.label: Preferences Card (notifications, theme, locale, currency token)
nodes.norm_label: preferences card (notifications, theme, locale, currency token)

nodes.label: App\Services\CurrencyFormatter
nodes.rationale: The only money formatter: resolves the runtime symbol from system_settings.currency_code through a native ICU locale map (BDT -> bn_BD) instead of hardcoding a symbol, and uses parentheses for negatives.

nodes.label: Walk-in Claim Code (WI-4821-KD)
nodes.rationale: A printed code lets staff link an unbooked visit to the correct account, so walk-in history merges instead of creating a duplicate patient record.

nodes.label: Per-Invoice Currency Snapshot
nodes.rationale: The currency is snapshotted per invoice so a later clinic-wide settings change never rewrites historical amounts.

nodes.label: Deviation: backups are private metadata snapshots
nodes.norm_label: deviation: backups are private metadata snapshots
nodes.rationale: Production would use a physical SQL dump; this project writes private metadata JSON so backup/verify/delete workflows are demonstrable without exporting password hashes.

nodes.label: Native ICU Locale Map for Currency Symbol Resolution (BDT to bn_BD)
nodes.norm_label: native icu locale map for currency symbol resolution (bdt to bn_bd)
nodes.rationale: Resolves symbols such as the taka sign from intl rather than hardcoding money symbols in any UI file; money is never shown with a literal dollar sign.

nodes.label: AI Symptom Checker Two-Stage Triage Pipeline
nodes.norm_label: ai symptom checker two-stage triage pipeline

nodes.label: FAQ Chatbot Widget with Medical Safety Guardrails
nodes.norm_label: faq chatbot widget with medical safety guardrails

nodes.label: Clinical Safety Console (Admin)
nodes.rationale: Single admin surface for deterministic emergency/symptom behaviour; rule edits are logged and broadcast instantly so no role runs a stale safety table.

nodes.label: Emergency Information (Guest)
nodes.rationale: Public, login-free, offline-cached page whose only job is to get someone off the site and on the phone; it explicitly refuses to offer bookings or chatbot as substitutes.

nodes.label: Cached-rules fail-safe on rules table failure
nodes.norm_label: cached-rules fail-safe on rules table failure
nodes.rationale: When the rules table fails to load, the chatbot/checker keep running cached rules and editing is disabled — safety behaviour survives an admin UI outage.

nodes.label: emergency_alert_rules (red-flag phrase table)
nodes.rationale: Phrase → category → severity rows with per-row Active switches; matching is exact/keyword per engine config so the emergency path never depends on AI.

nodes.label: Emergency contacts list (label / phone / category / sort)
nodes.norm_label: emergency contacts list (label / phone / category / sort)
nodes.rationale: Ordering is explicit (sort 1,2,4) and each contact has an Active switch, so the public emergency page order is admin-controlled rather than coded.

nodes.label: Stage-2 specialty cross-validation with Internal Medicine fallback
nodes.norm_label: stage-2 specialty cross-validation with internal medicine fallback
nodes.rationale: Unmatched symptom → Internal Medicine default plus a Retry hint, so the AI assist degrades to a safe deterministic answer rather than showing doctors an unvalidated specialty.

nodes.label: Symptom → specialty mapping
nodes.rationale: Specialty options are DB-backed (db:specialties.name) and unique mapping is enforced, so the AI's specialty suggestion can be cross-validated against a controlled table instead of free text.

nodes.label: Linked Stage-1 symptom check result
nodes.rationale: Shows the deterministic Stage-1 outcome ('clear', urgency hint) inline on the request so triage context arrives with the booking rather than in a separate system.

nodes.label: Data-view four-state pattern (success / skeleton / empty / error+retry)
nodes.norm_label: data-view four-state pattern (success / skeleton / empty / error+retry)
nodes.rationale: Every data region ships all four states behind radio toggles so empty and failure paths are designed, reviewed and demoed rather than discovered in production; skeletons match final metrics to avoid layout shift.

nodes.label: In-stream emergency interception by deterministic rules
nodes.norm_label: in-stream emergency interception by deterministic rules
nodes.rationale: A matched red flag ('crushing chest pain') hijacks the conversation into a call-now panel labelled Stage-1 — the emergency path never waits on or depends on AI output.

nodes.label: Time-bounded clinic alert banner (emergency_alert_banners)
nodes.rationale: Admin-managed notice with an explicit active window, so a temporary disruption (ambulance paused on Ring Road) never becomes permanent emergency copy.

nodes.label: Service-worker offline cache
nodes.rationale: Page and numbers are stored on device after first load so emergency guidance opens without network — the one page where a network dependency is unacceptable.

nodes.label: One-tap tel: call cards
nodes.rationale: Numbers come from emergency_contacts (label, phone, category, sort), never hardcoded; empty/error states fall back to 911 rather than rendering an empty emergency list.

nodes.label: Red-flag symptom categories (cardiac, respiratory, stroke, anaphylaxis…)
nodes.norm_label: red-flag symptom categories (cardiac, respiratory, stroke, anaphylaxis...)
nodes.rationale: Same emergency_alert_rules the checker and chatbot use, published as an accordion so a guest can self-recognise a red flag without any AI in the loop.

nodes.label: Bug 10: Empty Revenue Percentage Silently Falling Back to 10 Percent
nodes.norm_label: bug 10: empty revenue percentage silently falling back to 10 percent
nodes.rationale: Revenue share was computed in the browser with a hardcoded 10 percent fallback, producing incorrect Admin commission and doctor payouts.

nodes.label: Global Dynamic Currency and Locale Setting
nodes.norm_label: global dynamic currency and locale setting

nodes.label: Stored Revenue Percentage with Server-Side Commission Calculation
nodes.norm_label: stored revenue percentage with server-side commission calculation
